description: IA-50 c/n 09 (September 1967), carried President Alfonsín in 1988, retired November 1998; erected 22 September 2002 on private land at the north access to Crespo, painted with the fictitious serial T-118, and deteriorating; a 2026 council proposal seeks to relocate it to public space.
